name: Colonies (bonding switched on)
description: Cells can stay together: a gene gives the chance that a baby stays attached to its parent. Bonded cells are held close like linked beads, move together and share energy. Here a third of the first generation's babies bond from the start so you can watch colonies form; set the starting bond chance to 0 to see whether bonding evolves on its own. Color the dots by Colony size.
